messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@cloudopsinc.com>, Samir Shah <samir@nimbuscons.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace contracting & tech kickoff: co-sell scope and listing milestones

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the productive partner planning session last week. I wanted to pull together a short kickoff thread to align contracting milestones (MAPP / co-sell paperwork), the technical validation steps for the listing, and the owner for each action so we have a clear timeline into the marketplace listing and joint go-to-market.

High-level ask: can CloudOps and Nimbus confirm the co-sell eligibility items below and whether you can deliver the technical artifacts by the dates suggested? Redwood will own the marketplace submission, co-sell request, and the first pass of the MAPP draft.

Proposed milestones (tentative)
- May 7: Marketplace technical artifacts (container image, solution overview, 1-pager) — owner: CloudOps
- May 10: MAPP / co-sell draft from Redwood + initial legal redlines — owner: Redwood (Laura + Marcus)
- May 14: Joint validation call with AWS partner ops / Azure SME (set up by partners)
- May 20: Submit listing to marketplace and open co-sell request

Immediate asks
1) Elena: confirm timeline for the artifacts above and whether CloudOps needs any example templates from us (I attached our checklist).
2) Samir: can Nimbus confirm the systems integration test window (we requested a 48h window after artifact delivery) and who will be the test lead?
3) Marcus / Karthik / Steph: please review the draft MAPP I’ll drop into Drive and propose any non-negotiable legal/ops items by Tue EOD.

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_checklist_v1.pdf (checklist + required artifact examples), co-sell-mapp-draft-4821.docx (placeholder, initial draft coming from Redwood)

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear plan. CloudOps can deliver the container image and solution overview by May 7; I’ve flagged a few dependencies with our security team but they look like low-lift (we’ll provide attestations). We’ll need the template for the solution overview — please share the Drive link.

For the test lead: Priya Menon will own the integration test. She’s cc’d on this thread (Priya.M@cloudopsinc.com). Priya can schedule the 48h SIT window once she has the artifacts.

We’ll also coordinate with AWS Partner Ops to book the joint validation call (we have a contact there: aws-partner-ops@amazon.com).

Elena

Laura / team —

I reviewed the MAPP draft (thanks Laura). A couple of quick redlines from an operational perspective:
- We should add a clear SLA matrix for inference latency SLOs tied to co-sell tiering (this prevents scope creep during joint customer demos).
- Include a fallback routing clause that defines which variant we serve if dedicated capacity is unavailable during co-sell leads.
- For procurement: suggest we keep the pricing footnote flexible for 90 days post-listing (pricing often changes during early co-sell runs).

I’ll annotate the doc with inline comments and push version 1.1 by EOD. Marcus — can you confirm the legal contacts for signature?

Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference

- For co-sell MAPP: we should include a section limiting liability for jointly marketed demo environments — I’ll propose language.

I’ve uploaded a redlined MAPP into the Drive link (see related_links).

Thanks everyone — this looks good from Nimbus’ side. Priya confirmed the SIT lead and will send the checklist by EOD tomorrow (May 6).

Quick clarification: for co-sell motion do we need separate marketplace offers for AWS vs Azure, or will a single multi-cloud listing suffice initially? Elena / Laura — any preference?

If multi-cloud listing is acceptable, Nimbus can adapt the deployment README to include both deployment manifests. If vendors prefer separate offers for marketplace co-sell benefit, we can plan that as a follow-up phase.

Samir
Principal Solutions Architect, Nimbus Consulting
